## 🌐 GLOBEX AI — MASTER TRADE AUTOMATION WORKFLOW

**ZERO-SQL OPERATION:**
All 5 business workflows operate 100% in-memory with live FastAPI ML connectors. No PostgreSQL, Supabase, or external database credentials needed.

**5 INTEGRATED SUB-PIPELINES:**
1. 🧠 **AI Trade Intelligence & Anomaly Engine** (`POST /webhook/analyze-trade` & `/webhook/test-trade-analysis`)
2. 📄 **Document OCR & Compliance Verification** (`POST /webhook/document-uploaded`)
3. 🤝 **Marketplace Institutional Buyer Matcher** (`POST /webhook/marketplace-match`)
4. 🔐 **Trade Lifecycle & Escrow Vault Creation** (`POST /webhook/create-trade`)
5. 🚢 **Maritime Tracking & Vessel Geofencing** (`POST /webhook/track-shipment`)

**MODELS CONNECTED:**
- `3yr Moving-Average Forecaster` (demand MT & expected FOB price $/kg — walk-forward backtested against a Dual-Head GRU, which was 2x worse and is disabled; see reports/production/phase4b_outputs)
- `XGBoost Anomaly Detector` + `Unsupervised IsolationForest Screen` (historical trade deviations; two separate, never-blended signals — see src/trade_anomaly/unsupervised_screen.py)
- `Counterparty Risk Profiler` (composite trust & dispute scoring; real screening against 31,629 OFAC/UN/UK/EU sanctioned entities when DB-backed)
- `CEPA & Tariff Rules Engine` (documented bilateral agreements; real WITS TRAINS MFN tariff lookup for undocumented corridors)
- `Catalogue HS Code Classifier` (HS6 international tariff resolution)
- `Document OCR Engine` (cross-border bill of lading & invoice parser)
